requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named SponsorCredibility with fields sponsor_type, funding_source, institution_name, collaborators, reputation_score, and transparency_flag.
The system must include raw ClinicalTrials.gov fields lead_sponsor, collaborators, and funding_source in the schema as input-mapped attributes.
The system must enforce sponsor_type as an enumerated value limited to university, hospital, pharma, or unknown.
The system must enforce funding_source as an enumerated value limited to public, industry, other, or undisclosed.
The system must define institution_name as a non-empty string when lead_sponsor data is present.
The system must represent collaborators as a list of strings, allowing multiple collaborating organizations.
The system must define reputation_score as a numeric field that allows null values when not yet computed.
The system must define transparency_flag as a boolean indicating whether funding source information is disclosed.
The system must successfully parse and validate a complete ClinicalTrials.gov sponsor payload into the SponsorCredibility schema without errors.
The system must allow missing collaborators field and default it to an empty list.
The system must handle missing lead_sponsor data by setting institution_name to null and sponsor_type to unknown.
The system must raise a validation error if sponsor_type is provided outside the allowed enumeration values.
The system must raise a validation error if collaborators is not provided as a list structure.
